notes.title: Viking Frontiers - a few words from the team
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It has already been [b]three weeks since the release of Viking Frontiers on Steam[/b], and thus we want to take a moment to share our thoughts on the current state of the title and our plans for its future. Launching the game was an incredible milestone for our team, but at the same time, it’s only the beginning of our journey. 

Please know, that [b]we are fully committed to continuously improving and polishing the Viking Frontiers project[/b] to make it even more enjoyable and fun to play for you all. The regular hotfixes we’ve been releasing are just the first steps, and we plan to keep updating the game to further enhance your experience. And we can't do it without you.


[h2]The saga continues 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/69d4e98a3f55ff93c252556468c4b37dd3a8f058.png[/img]

As you surely know, we are [b]actively listening to your feedback[/b] and greatly appreciate every honest opinion and constructive comment. Your insights help us understand your perspective better and allow us to make [b]meaningful changes together. [/b] Your input, reports and suggestions are carefully analyzed, recorded and - where possible - tested, so please keep them coming!

Listening to your voices, we are totally aware that the game is not yet free from issues, and know that some [b]mechanics still need to be explained more clearly[/b], as they are frequently brought up in player questions. Rest assured, we’re working on making these aspects more intuitive and accessible. This includes aspects such as expanding buildings with new devices, using the sawmill modes, fishing and more.

[h2]We build this clan together 🤝[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img]
[/url]
We believe that together with our community, we are building a Viking clan where cooperation and dedication are key. [b]With hard work and thoughtful improvements[/b], we are confident that Viking Frontiers will become a beloved survival game among fans worldwide, one step at a time. Thank you for being part of this journey - your support and passion mean the world to us!

The easiest way to reach our team and get an answer to your question is through [url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][b]our Discord server[/b][/url]. Be sure to join!


[h3]Skål!
The Viking Frontiers Team[/h3]

notes.title: Jarl's Guide #7 - Tools & Weapon Crafting 🔨
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that[b] managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor[/b] fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous [b]valuable tips are coming to your aid.[/b]

This time we will focus on one of the most useful skills out there, which will be crucial in all stages of the game. Regardless of whether you are a naked shipwreck, the ruler of a small settlement, or the Jarl of a large community, [b]this activity will accompany you all the time.[/b] 🛠️ Roll up your sleeves, everyone, we have a lot of work ahead of us!


[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/a5f8bdf5c07531fb0f75365695413dfaf32cff79.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]Your first contact with crafting 🫰[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
At the beginning of your adventure, as a lonely survivor, you will only have your wits and your hands at your disposal. And it is at this early stage that [b]your career as a craftsman will begin![/b] Remember that the environment around you contains[b] plenty of resources[/b] that can be turned into useful tools 🪨 These may be sticks, stones, lumps of metal, or plant elements. Be sure to collect them all, as you never know when they will come in handy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/288ce91068be8e433b1cd437575e22138e04aa56.gif[/img]

The first tools you will craft will be stone tools - simple and low quality, but still helpful and ready to make without [b]any additional help other than your own hands.[/b] Handcrafting will allow you to make, for example, a knife, a pickaxe, or a hammer, which will teach you the basics of crafting and tools usage. 

During each crafting action, regardless of what item you are creating, the [b]crafting panel will tell you exactly what resources and items you need to proceed.[/b] This way, you will always know if you are ready to start your work on the tool or weapon you need.


[h2]In pursuit of better quality ⚒️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Once you successfully reunite with your clan, you will quickly discover that stone tools are not enough. Fortunately, the [b]workshop and its workbench[/b] will come to your aid. Thanks to the mentioned workbench, you will be able to prepare more advanced tools... as long as you manage to obtain the appropriate resources needed to create them first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/0a974dfd4ccb1660c2ffa2d54bc9135f867c3c65.gif[/img]

The production of more advanced tools often requires not only valuable resources, but also the preparation of [b]semi-finished products or elements[/b]. These may be metal bars, handles, or ax heads. Some of the items are simpler, while others are much more complicated, thus crafting them is more time-consuming and requires, for example, access to a forge or tannery. 

As you probably guessed, higher quality tools will allow you to perform new activities (like mining harder varieties of metal ores) or make your work faster and more enjoyable (for example while chopping down the trees) 🌲.  Remember that [b]your clan folk can also use various types of tools [/b]that you have made for them, and their quality and type will significantly affect their effectiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/b56a51a9efdec14027a89fffb83e550e0dee4254.gif[/img]


[h2]Top tier weapons, armor and tools 🏅[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[b]The culmination of your career[/b] as a craftsman will be the creation of magnificent steel tools that are unmatched in speed and efficiency. However, the best of the best are famous for creating beautiful yet deadly weapons and armor 🛡️

When you go to the forest, where you can encounter various types of beasts, you will quickly appreciate the steel spear, which will give you a much better chance of survival than its stone counterpart. [b]The same applies to your warriors[/b], who need good equipment that will help them cope with even the most unfavorable conditions. When you give them high-quality swords, axes, spears, or shields, almost nothing will be able to stop them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/278f49afb6be06d6c428a404763046e1a00ac58d.gif[/img]

As you can see, crafting is one of the most important skills you can learn. It will be useful to you at every stage of the game and will have a huge impact on the development of your settlement. Remember to always use your resources wisely so that you can freely craft what your Viking community needs the most. [b]Happy crafting, Jarl![/b]


[h3]Join the clan[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We hope you find the seventh entry in our series helpful and interesting. Now that you have all the necessary knowledge about crafting, it's time for you to test your skills in practice.

Ah, one more thing - and this is important 😁 Do not forget to wishlist the [b]Viking Frontiers Prologue version on this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/]Steam Page »[/url] [/b] and sign up for the upcoming Playtest!



[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that[b] managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor[/b] fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous [b]valuable tips are coming to your aid.[/b]

It's time to take care of the bellies of our clansfolk and make sure that their tables will never run out of food, so much needed in the [b]harsh Nordic lands.[/b] The [b]specter of famine is one of the Vikings' greatest fears[/b] ☠️ so your task will be to make sure that hunger never knocks on the gates of your settlement. But...[b] how to do it?[/b]


[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/a5f8bdf5c07531fb0f75365695413dfaf32cff79.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]Farming as one of the most stable food sources 👩‍🌾[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Soil, if used properly, can produce abundant crops that will fill your granaries. Well... easier said than done! Farming requires not only appropriate [b]knowledge and skills, but also specialized tools.[/b] But let's start from the beginning -  the first step in your agriculture adventure will be choosing the right place where your fields will be created. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/483be66e9814f28f590d248353ad87c29af752dd.gif[/img]

[h3]Farmer guide - step by step:[/h3]

1️⃣. Take a moment to walk around your settlement and decide where you want to plant the first farms 🌾 The [b]location should be flat and free from any rocks or trees.[/b] When you find the perfect spot, use the radial menu to set up your first fields.

2️⃣. [b]Only fertile soil can grow crops[/b]. Therefore, the next step will be to enrich it with a special fertilizer. At this point, you will need a shovel that will allow you to perform this crucial action.

3️⃣. After the fields are made fertile, they need to be [b]dug up and loosened with a hoe[/b]. Break through the tough soil, reach the deeper layers, and get it ready for planting seeds.

4️⃣. Now it's time to plant seeds in your fields. Select the crop that fits your needs best (like cabbage, turnips, carrots, grain or other) and [b]spread the seeds across the prepared soil.[/b]

5️⃣. And now... [b]we wait![/b] Remember, that while you wait for the harvest, you can take care of other important matters and activities.

6️⃣. The final and [b]most rewarding stage is harvesting.[/b] Take your sickle, head to the fields, and gather the golden grain or other valuable crops. Well done! Now your people won’t have to worry about hunger and can enjoy the fruits of your labor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/092fce03250e20b1030b8df94d2278ad4d5f50e6.gif[/img]


[h2]Animal breeding 🐮[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Animal breeding is the perfect complement to farming. Animal products will help you supplement your food supply and [b]make your fellow Vikings happier. [/b] Animals such as cows and chickens have found their place in human settlements for thousands of years, and [b]your foothold is no exception.[/b]

Unlike crops, animals need a roof over their heads 🐔 With that in mind, start by building a Chicken Coop or a Barn to house your first flocks. When the structures are ready, [b]place the animals in them.[/b] To obtain eggs, milk or meat, you need to make sure your livestock have something to eat. And this is where agriculture comes in handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/f156f092aa491ad009935a625d1bc2eb87a8be39.jpg[/img]

Your animals will happily eat agricultural produce that you obtain from your fields. Remember to [b]maintain the right balance[/b] between what is intended for people and what is intended for livestock 🍽️ By doing so, you will guarantee that your people are fed for good, enabling them to address other vital issues that will [b]further strengthen and enhance your settlement.[/b]

We hope you find the sixth entry in our series helpful and interesting. Now that you have all the necessary knowledge about the farming and breeding, it's time for you to test your skills in practice.

notes.title: Jarl's Guide #5 - Gods of the North 🙏
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that[b] managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor[/b] fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous [b]valuable tips are coming to your aid.[/b]

Today, we will immerse ourselves in the spiritual sphere and engage in deep prayers...[b] Sounds mysterious?[/b] This is exactly what the Gods of the Nordic lands are like - mysterious, thorny and [b]powerful beyond human understanding[/b]⚡ This is why you should always want to have them as your allies! Let's try to gain their favor so that they will help us develop our settlement and guide our swords in the fights [b]against our enemies.[/b]


[h2]The Pantheon awaits your prayers 🙏[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Nordic mythology is full of [b]almighty beings and divine figures[/b]. The all-knowing Odin, thunder-wielding Thor, cunning Loki, kind Frigg, and brave Tyr are just to begin with. As Jarl of the Viking clan, you will be responsible for establishing [b]relationships with some of the Gods[/b] and, if possible, gaining their favor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/283d1de22a438ee9167f6ad39bca9327c0a06477.gif[/img]

To do this, you will need to take several important steps. First of all, you can only interact with Gods through appropriate sacred places, such as Altars. [b]Altars are ancient, often forgotten and lost landmarks[/b] that were used to honor patrons by your ancestors 📜 Your first task, therefore, will be to find the lost Altar in your area, clear it of vines and overgrowth, and [b]restore it to its former glory.[/b]

Altars are frequently concealed in secluded mountains or deep ravines, making finding them a true challenge. However, if you manage to reach and rebuild them, the [b]Gods will surely appreciate your efforts.[/b]


[h2]Rituals as a way of communicating with the Gods 🕯️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Before you begin the rituals and prayers that may draw [b]the pantheon's gaze upon you[/b], you must first rebuild the Altar. The stone slabs themselves, although beautiful and intricately arranged, are not enough. When you're ready, gather the appropriate materials and grab your construction hammer to build [b]an offering bench and place candles, herbs, or other mystical objects.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/9d366b0ab11d77ab14698c14c63f58c64b10e0ec.gif[/img]

And so, you are ready to begin! First, decide which God you want to honor with your offerings, keeping in mind that each of them [b]specializes in different aspects of the life[/b] of the northern peoples. Let Odin, father of the pantheon, be our example this time, ok?

After selecting Odin as the recipient of our prayers, we must choose what [b]items or goods to sacrifice[/b] to pay him tribute. These may be food, valuable animal parts obtained during hunting, all kinds of riches, precious items or weapons ⚔️ The higher their value, [b]the greater the chance of gaining a patron's favor.[/b] For each such offering, you will receive [b]Favor Points[/b], which we will talk about down below.

The initial offerings at the beginning of your adventure will be rather simple and "cheap", however, as you progress further, they will become [b]much more significant.[/b] Nonetheless, earning Favor Points is a worthwhile investment as they can provide you with...


[h2]Gods favors and graces ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
But why exactly should you seek the support of the Northern Gods at all? What can they offer you that is so valuable that you would waste important resources on their behalf? Well... [b]excellent question![/b]

As you know, religion was an incredibly important element in the life of every Viking, providing them (if they died in an honorable way) a place at the eternally lavish feast 🍖 You, as Jarl, [b]an exalted man created for great purposes[/b], are closer to them than other mortals. This is not only a huge privilege, but also a responsibility.

That being said, it's entirely up to you how you use the Favor Points you earn. By spending them, you can for example ask the Gods to support you in the upcoming battles against other clans 💀 Favor Points can also be spent to [b]perform numerous rituals[/b], which will provide you with all kinds of blessings and graces! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/1d45a9089eaa39aeb3e6600f99c0a43ee6d9c8d1.gif[/img]

The powerful [b]Gods may therefore back you up in the fight[/b]. Thanks to their wisdom, you can accelerate the development of new technologies or ask them for help when your research gets stuck. Sacred entities have the power to clear thick fog from distant areas, allowing you to explore [b]new, rich lands.[/b] They are also an element of the Rune system... which we will tell you about in the next entries of our series. 

Without the support of the Gods, your settlement [b]will have a hard time[/b] expanding its influence and simply surviving. They are an [b]integral part of every Viking's life[/b], including yours... for better or for worse. Fortunately, now you know how to get [b]valuable Favor Points[/b] and put them to good use.

notes.title: Jarl's Guide #4 - Wilderness and hunting 🏹
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that[b] managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor[/b] fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous [b]valuable tips are coming to your aid.[/b]

This series -[b] The Jarl’s Guide[/b] - will help you understand the wild, harsh world around you and support you in your difficult efforts 📜 Read on, and discover how to deal with various unpredictable situations and how to go down in history as a glorious, respectable Jarl. [b]Valhalla![/b]


[h2]Dense forests and tangled thickets are waiting to be discovered! 🌲🌳[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
From the very first moment you enter the world of Viking Frontiers, you will find yourself [b]surrounded by trees, bushes, dense thickets[/b], and smaller plants like berries and herbs. Many of these pristine areas have never even been visited by any human before. It is this [b]wilderness that will become an indispensable element[/b] of the landscape that you will encounter at every step of your adventure... and you should consider yourself lucky! Why is that so?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/4fa59243028aecd464a375742d03a014b1149fbc.gif[/img]

It turns out that the wilderness (despite its numerous threats) is a [b]source of many valuable raw materials and food[/b], without which your settlement would quickly fall into ruin. As a wise, effective Jarl, you need to recognize both the [b]opportunities and perils that come with venturing into the forests.[/b] And so, this is what we will devote today's Guide to - your survival in the mysterious, impenetrable wilderness. It's time to face the power of nature - come with us... and try not to get lost 🦌!


[h2]Let the hunt begin 🏹[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As we mentioned above, the forest is a source of many important raw materials, including wood, berries, mushrooms, herbs, stones, sticks and... many, many other useful goods. Today, however, we will focus on one [b]particularly important activity[/b] that requires appropriate skills and cunning 🎯  It's time to grab your equipment, Jarl. Let the hunt begin...

[h4]Since we brought it up, let's start with your equipment, without which no hunt can be successful:
[/h4]

• [b]The spear[/b] is considered the simplest, although still very effective hunting tool. It consists of a long handle, ensuring a firm grip, and a sharp tip, whose task is to knock down our prey. The crucial aspect of using this weapon is to quietly approach the target and then deliver a strong, precise throw. The better the materials a spear is made of, the better its effectiveness, so always try to obtain materials that will allow you to make improvements.

• [b]The bow[/b] made of an appropriate type of wood allows you to shoot arrows with great speed and accuracy. And so, this weapon's advantage is its ability to make several quick shots, unlike the spear, which only offers a single chance to strike. As the bow and arrows become more advanced, their use becomes easier and more effective, granting you an advantage over forest dwellers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/0e7320fdea959f4dbf49a151988816d2a86ee532.gif[/img]

Now that you've chosen your favorite hunting equipment, let's talk about your preys. The forests surrounding your settlement are full of wild animals, but there is a fundamental difference between their types. Some of them are timid and eager to run away... while [b]others can kill you[/b] 💀

The first category consists of foxes, rabbits, and deer, whereas the second includes boars, wolves, and bears. Remember, however, that [b]the greater the risk, the greater the reward![/b] 

When sneaking up on animals, try to discover their features, i.e. speed, alertness, range of sight and hearing - [b]each of them has its own strengths and weaknesses.[/b] This task may be easier due to the fact that hunting is somewhat simpler at night, and you can enhance your abilities with special ointments and potions. 


[h2]How can efficient hunting improve the life of your settlement? 🧐[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Once you've successfully slain an animal,[b] it's time to gather essential resources[/b]. Perhaps the most important of them is life-giving meat, which is an important element of your community's diet. Different kinds of animals [b]provide meat of different qualities[/b], and the best among them allow you to prepare rations that are considered a specialty among your people... mainly because they fill their bellies for a long, long time 🍖

Another important raw material is leather. After appropriate processing at the Tanner, tanned hides become one of the components [b]needed to craft tools, items or armor.[/b] Without them, the further development of your settlement would be almost impossible. The same applies to bones, claws and antlers, which are used in rituals to gain the favor of the gods.  

The larger and [b]more dangerous the animal, the better its skin, bones and meat 🐻🐗[/b] This is why the bravest hunters hold a high rank in Viking society. In the later stages of the game, you will be able to [b]entrust your hunters[/b] with expeditions into the wilderness, although from time to time you should also set an example, and [b]kill one of the roaming beasts yourself! [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/22aaedce857d24239da5043ac5a6724e882fbc95.gif[/img]


We hope you find the fourth entry in our series helpful and interesting. Now that you have all the necessary knowledge about the wilderness and hunting, it's time for you to test your skills in practice! notes.title: Jarl's Guide #3 - Prologue version of the game and the Building System
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that[b] managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor[/b] fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous [b]valuable tips are coming to your aid.[/b]

This series -[b] The Jarl’s Guide[/b] - will help you understand the wild, harsh world around you and support you in your difficult efforts 📜 Read on, and discover how to deal with various unpredictable situations and how to go down in history as a glorious, respectable Jarl. [b]Valhalla![/b]


[h2]But before we get to the Building System, let us invite you to Wishlist the ➡️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/]Viking Frontiers Prologue! [/url]⬅️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/10a61bb87cea1bcdeba5cc1dae7eb7fbd8a5129f.png[/img]
[/url]
The Prologue is another very important step towards the release of Viking Frontiers in its full version, and that is why [b]we hope you will join us in this awesome event[/b]. As you know, we deeply appreciate your feedback, opinions, and reviews, recognizing them as indispensable tools for refining and enhancing our titles. The Demo version, despite the fact that it was not completely free of problems, [b]was enthusiastically and warmly received by players[/b] around the world 😍 and we aim to repeat this situation again!

Viking Frontiers Prologue will be much richer in content than the mentioned Demo, and will [b]include almost all the mechanics that will appear in the full version[/b] of the game, although in their slightly truncated, work-in-progress form. Thus, you will face many new challenges, as well as numerous difficult decisions, new management options and [b]features you have never seen before[/b] in our title.

If you'd like to learn a little more about the Prologue version and [b]add it to your Steam Wishlist[/b] ✅ be sure to visit [b]this dedicated [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/]Steam Page » [/url][/b]


[h2]Back to the Jarl's Guide and the Building System ⚒️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Now that we've discussed the release Prologue, we can move on to today's subject. The Building System is [b]one of the most basic mechanics[/b] you will encounter during your Viking Frontiers adventure. Without the option to construct new buildings and structures, you'll lack the means to provide [b]shelter for yourself and your tribe[/b], initiate the production of vital goods, engage in crafting, or expand your settlement. Make no mistake - in the harsh Nordic lands, it's equivalent to death. That's why the real Jarls are not afraid to take the hammer in their hands and [b]get to work![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/381ad27f2edce3c2361c7e78d557f07f5d57e497.gif[/img]


Your people are in need, so let's make haste. Once you decide to place a new building and have chosen a suitable location, select the building option. When you do this, you will see a circular panel where you can choose [b]the building blueprint of your choice[/b] 🗺️ [b]Good job![/b] All you have to do now is place it on the construction site (remember to avoid obstacles, such as trees or boulders).

Once the planning phase is completed, the construction phase begins. Before you start your work, however, you must first [b]prepare the appropriate building materials[/b]. Depending on the advancement of the building you have chosen, these will be simple resources such as thatch, clay, or smaller stones or more complex materials like boards, boulders and logs, that require prior processing. Once you know what materials the facility you are building requires, take them to the construction site.


[h2]With hammer, wood and stone  🔨[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It's time to set the hammer in motion! But first things first - the [b]building process is divided into stages and elements.[/b] You can think of Stages as pieces that hold the structure together (pillars, walls, roof, etc.) Every construction work begins with them, and they constitute the backbone of the structure you are placing. However, walls and a roof alone are not enough to make the new place useful! 🏗️ This is where the elements come in. The [b]elements include all types of devices[/b], furniture and production stations that we will soon use for work. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/925ed15237c999a375da1f6bc8ac751323885c02.gif[/img]


Ok, now it's time for the most fun part. [b]Grab your hammer[/b] and hit the white parts of the building to bring them to new life - stage by stage, element by element. When you complete them all, the construction phase is finished and your settlement is able to enjoy a new useful place to live, work, produce or store goods. Remember that there are [b]many different buildings at your disposal[/b], and each of them has its own unique purpose, so it is worth choosing the right strategy and the order in which they are built 🧐

New buildings and their capabilities are the [b]key to survival[/b] in these wild lands. As your tribe develops, your settlement will include, for example, a forge, tannery, port, sawmill, cowshed and many, many more! The more subjects under your command and the greater your ambitions, the more advanced workshops, warehouses and structures you will need. This is why every Jarl must be familiar with the Building System and know how to put their [b]hammers to good use! [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/2dab2a4c7d80d9b80141a8edffee9fb4c3b00930.gif[/img]


We hope you find the third entry in our series helpful and interesting. Now that you have all the necessary knowledge about the Building System, constructing new structures and planning your next steps as a Jarl, we can only wish you good luck! Ah, one more thing - and this is important 😁 Do not forget to wishlist the [b]Viking Frontiers Prologue version on this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/]Steam Page »[/url] [/b]

notes.title: Jarl's Guide #2 - Obtaining the Resources and Playtest launch date reveal
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that[b] managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor[/b] fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous [b]valuable tips are coming to your aid.[/b]

This series -[b] The Jarl’s Guide[/b] - will help you understand the wild, harsh world around you and support you in your difficult efforts 📜 Read on, and discover how to deal with various unpredictable situations and how to go down in history as a glorious, respectable Jarl. [b]Valhalla![/b]


[h2]Good news, everyone! The Viking Frontiers Playtest will kick off on January 15th[/h2]
[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/7512ddf6c2fb1d56705ae4cf4c6913cbe697a8a5.png[/img]

The Playtest will start in less than a week, which means you still have some time to [b]request access[/b] and become one of our testers. To do so, please visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/]Viking Frontiers Steam Page[/url] and click the green Request Access button just above the RECENT EVENTS & ANNOUNCEMENTS section ✅

Truth be told, we simply can't wait to see the first daredevils who will try their best to survive and develop their settlements among the hostile Nordic hills and woods 🌲 [b]Will you be able[/b] to obtain the necessary resources (which we will talk about in a moment)? Will you keep your people safe and gain their trust? And most importantly - will you manage to build a [b]prosperous settlement?[/b]

We are also eagerly waiting for your first feedback and general opinions about Viking Frontiers. The Steam Playtest marks the initial interaction of the gaming community with our title, and we rely on you to share your thoughts and ideas, which will help us further improve our game. In the past, you have proven many times [b]what great testers you all are[/b], so we are looking at the calendar with great hope and enthusiasm! 😍


[h2]And now - let us get back to the Jarl's Guide[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Now that we've discussed the Playtest release date, we can focus on your survival 💀 Although the forests, rivers, hills and cliffs surrounding your new home are fraught with danger, traversing them can be extremely rewarding. And it's not just about the [b]magnificent views! [/b]The environment around your settlement is full of valuable resources just waiting to be used. However, before they become long, wooden boards, useful tools, tough metal bars, or delicious dishes, [b]you first need to obtain them.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/50e3714d9bb5d1adf962e6fcfd68d4ef676e87ec.gif[/img]


The raw materials you can possess include various types of plants and herbs, wood, stone, iron ore, wild animal skins and many more. As you can see, this is quite a wide range of goods, so you will have to plan your extraction activities wisely and try to [b]maximize their results[/b]. Speaking of efficiency, we have to mention tools, which are a very important element of quick and effective resource acquisition 🪓

Regardless of whether we are talking about picks, axes, saws or other tools, their use will definitely speed up your work. Be sure to remember about them [b]both in the early and later stages of the game[/b]! When setting out into the wilderness, check twice if your equipment includes the appropriate items that will make it easier to achieve your goals.


[h2]Resources equals development 🧐[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Once you enter the world of Viking Frontiers, you will quickly discover that creating any tool or building any building requires access to certain raw materials. When building the first houses of your settlement, which will later provide shelter for your tribesmen, or [b]constructing more complex buildings[/b] such as a barn or a forge, you will have to use beams, boards, stones and other building materials. Unfortunately, their quantity is limited and empty warehouses never portends anything good. Ok, but how to make sure your settlement doesn't lack important resources? 🤔


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/409403b0fd496928951d199ebdc08bb6584c0f48.gif[/img]


As stated earlier, the simplest method involves embarking on an expedition around your village and personally gathering resources. However in the future, when your settlement is a bit more developed and has the appropriate number of workers, you will be able to commission work to your subjects. 

As a [b]Jarl of a prosperous town[/b], you won't always have time to go out into the wild on your own to obtain valuable resources, and you will have to let your tribemates do some of the work instead of you 🤝 This is undoubtedly [b]a convenient solution [/b]- lumberjacks, hunters and miners will provide you with a constant supply of important goods, which will also allow you to devote yourself to others, [b]more absorbing tasks.[/b] Of course, if you miss the wilderness you can still embark on the rescue-gathering journey, but then it will be your choice, not a necessity.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/f4880cd890ee4fd3b439eb4b92f4e2eb75910b00.gif[/img]


Now that you have all the necessary knowledge about raw resources, their usefulness and ways to obtain them, we can only wish you good luck! Ah, one more thing - do not forget to join the Viking Frontiers Playtest and join us on January 15th. [b]See you then![/b] 👀



[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

Although at first glance it seems quite simple, believe us… [b]the devil is in the details 🔱[/b] In future entries of this series, we will delve much deeper into the different types of raw materials, buildings you can erect, production systems, or combat, but for now all you need is a general idea.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/4846b19eeaefa15174ef7b4c3779fcf15e5e1ecc.gif[/img]


But... how did you actually get here? Well, no matter how far back in history we look, we will always find ambitious rulers wanting to expand their influence and territories. And it is no different this time.  [b]Acting on the command of the great Jarl[/b], you have been dispatched to uncharted territories with the objective of conquering and bringing them into submission, establishing a new realm under your ruler's authority 🧭 However, deep within, you sense that there is something more to it… a second, hidden meaning. What could it be? And why does your master care so much about it? The time for such deliberations will arrive soon, but first you will have to secure the survival of both yourself and your people.

It will be your task to build (often with your own hand!) 🔨 the very first shelter in your settlement, and then develop it further and further by building more advanced production, residential, or military buildings. Your tribesmen and you cannot function without a roof over your head, food storage, and many other useful facilities, can you now? Thanks to smart planning and an addictive building system, your camp will soon turn into a small town full of life and interesting people. However, buildings alone are not enough - [b]the true spirit of your colony are your subjects.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/205ef8d8f7d004b81c0365735c669c406beccbf4.gif[/img]


[h2]People of your settlement[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
They are the ones who will, over time, take over part of your responsibilities and engage in various types of work. It is them who will be spending their working days in workshops, farmlands and other important facilities. You, as ruler, will have to distribute their work wisely and make sure they are productive and efficient. [b]Make no mistake[/b] - only joint effort can ensure your settlement's safety and prosperity, and no Jarl, no matter how powerful, cannot do on their own 🤓 That is why it is so important to take care of the needs of your subjects and provide them with appropriate living and working conditions. To do this, you will need...


[h2]Crafting goods, resources and…[/h2] 
[hr][/hr]
While there are some risks involved in exploring your surroundings, it is definitely worth taking a look around. The forests, mountains, and meadows around your settlement are [b]full of all kinds of valuable goods...[/b] 🌳 if you know where to look for them, of course! Wood, stones, ores, herbs and animals are just some points of a long list. Such raw materials constitute the basis for the production of more advanced goods that will help you survive in difficult Nordic conditions. Soon the hammers of blacksmiths will ring in your colony. There will also be lumberjacks, clothing manufacturers, cooks and many, many more - just like in any growing community.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/409403b0fd496928951d199ebdc08bb6584c0f48.gif[/img]


However, there is a catch to this promising vision. You must be aware that your growing influence is a thorn in the side of many local warlords and masters ⚔ Their hostile ambitions cannot remain unanswered! Will you be able to gather a team of battle-seasoned troops and send out your raids to destroy enemy forces? [b]Will you secure your influence and keep your honorable title of Jarl?[/b] Well… [b]only time will tell.[/b]

[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

The whim of the gods brought you to the shores of an unknown land. Will you prove to be an effective leader? Will you keep your tribe safe and prosperous? And in the end - will you survive in the mysterious, undiscovered land? Well... [b]there is only one way to find out![/b] 😉


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/afbfccc8be6720affb97df67a21c70c9611a2135.png[/img]
